Note on Financial Results:
Note: At point no.26 'Face value of equity share capital' of Rs.5 is the Face value per equity share.
(The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 30th May ,2025 had considered and approved the Stock Split/ Sub-division of every one equity share having face value of Rs.10/ each, fully paid UP, Into Two equity shares, having face value of Rs. 5/ -Each, fully paid-up and the same has been approved by the shareholders of the Company through Postal Ballot on 22nd July 2025. Further the Company has fixed 12th August 2025 as the "Record Date" tor determining the entitlement of eligible Equity Shareholders for the purpose of sub-division/split of equity shares of the Company. Accordingly, the equity shares has been increased from 3,09,61,500 Equity shares to 6,19,23,000 Equity shares.)

Note on Cash Flow Statement:
(1) Since there is no option to fill ‘adjustment for (Profit)/Loss on Sale of Property, plant & equipment’, ‘Provision No Longer Required Written Back’, 'Net Unrealised foreign exchange fluctuation (Gain)/Loss' in the utility, the same are shown in 'Other adjustment for non-cash items'.

The actual figures (Rs. in crore) are as follows:
(a) Adjustment for (Profit)/Loss on Sale of Property, plant & equipment: -0.75
(b) Provision No Longer Required Written Back: -0.02
(c) Goverment Grants (net):- -0.06

Clarification on Cash flow statement:
The amount written in ‘Adjustment for decrease (increase) in trade receivables, current’ includes trade and other receivables and represents both current as well non-current part.
The amount written in ‘Adjustment for decrease (increase) in trade payables, current’ includes trade and other payables and represents both current as well non-current part.
